Population increased in Norfolk

The estimated population of Norfolk in 2024 was 940,359 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Norfolk increased by 2.4%.

Age profile of Norfolk

The average (median) age stayed at 45.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Norfolk has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Norfolk's population of 940,359 usual residents was made up of:

  • 151,546 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.1%)
  • 554,074 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.9%)
  • 234,739 people aged 65 years and over, (25%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Norfolk has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Norfolk, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Norfolk
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Norfolk, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 3,420 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 7,385 births and 10,805 deaths in Norfolk.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 4,725 (0.5%). There were 35,013 people entering the area and 30,288 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Norfolk's population of 5,259 (0.6%) as a result of 9,326 people entering the area and 4,067 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Norfolk was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Norfolk in mid-2023 is 933,670.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,278 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 551 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,727 people.
